Greenville Spinners SCTAC Tuesday Ride

Greenville, SC · SCTAC / Donaldson · Road

Greenville Spinners SCTAC Tuesday Ride is a road group ride in Greenville, SC. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Greenville Spinners parking lot at SCTAC.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Greenville Spinners SCTAC Tuesday Ride group ride

The Spinners' weekly Tuesday evening ride on the closed perimeter roads of the old Donaldson air base. A 500-plus member club, so expect several groups. Details on pace and distance are on the club site.
